mismatch.message: makelevel: load_special() has no loader for special level "Wiz-goal"

summary: Wiz-goal has no registered loader. Port the whole Wizard Quest goal program and wire it into the existing special-level registry.

source.branch: Wizard Quest goal-level generation through makelevel -> makemaz -> load_special -> dat/Wiz-goal.lua.
callers: C mklev.c:makelevel -> mkmaze.c:makemaz -> sp_lev.c:load_special -> nhlua.c:load_lua executes dat/Wiz-goal.lua. JavaScript js/mklev.js:makelevel -> makemaz -> load_special looks up the proto in SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS; no Wiz-goal key is registered.
C wizcmds.c:wiz_load_splua -> sp_lev.c:load_special -> nhlua.c:load_lua. JavaScript js/wizcmds.js:wiz_load_splua routes through the same special-level loader registry.
dependencies: The first observed gap is the missing whole dat/Wiz-goal.lua program/registry entry, before its level descriptors execute. The current implementation uses the existing shared special-level API and registered QUEST_LEVEL_LOADERS; source review will verify every descriptor helper and production caller before implementation scope is claimed.

evidence: The admitted v53 evaluation challenges/evaluations/hosted-38314809018-1-v53.json at d2cfcd4eeb8033c4cc3f2dbc6cc66db543415f85 records 84/246 screens, 2392/3829 RNG calls, and 84/246 cursors, leaving 162 screens. Its canonical manifest digest is fc1feb3315c077db151a113cf6f5c2e1b26ed181b953547e7d3fcf1ad1f51e39; recording SHA-256 is f5a28426f31100ffccd99802cd3f1caa0931e859f930be4c2a91d79d08a2bd26; recipe SHA-256 is 33cd4077303a7cab27d2c94a802e7271711f1c00c90afe1f0cc116ea0d25129d.

A fresh strict C/JS differential using the admitted independent recipe reproduced the same stop at segment 1, zero-based step 85, key A. C begins nhlib.lua shuffle alignment with rn2(3) and presents the next level screen; JavaScript has no output after its previous 84 screens.

C mkmaze.c:1184-1193 selects the resolved special-level proto then calls sp_lev.c:load_special; load_special invokes nhlua.c:load_lua to execute the named dat program. JavaScript js/mklev.js:makemaz and load_special use SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS. The registered quest programs are collected from js/quest_levels.js:QUEST_LEVEL_LOADERS, but that registry has no Wiz-goal entry. The world-generation caller refuses at js/mklev.js:723 before any Wiz-goal body runs.

Read dat/Wiz-goal.lua as the actual source owner. The missing behavior includes its level initialization, maze flags and map, regions, locked doors and stairs, non-diggable boundary, altar and fixed/random object placement, random traps, Dark One and hostile monster classes, and captive-monster setup. This is a missing whole program, not a Dark One dialogue defect. The named full Lua program and its loader registration are the implementation target; later descriptor/helper gaps, if any, must be enumerated before edits.
